notes.title: DLC - Fan Book and OST
notes.content: The DLC for this game has just been updated. If you enjoyed the game, you will not want to miss out on the fan book. This 35-page art book includes drafts, designs, full-resolution images and exclusive artwork by other artists. This package also includes all the OSTs that we made. We hope you will enjoy it!
